subject: Undergraduate internship inquiry — Minji Kim, DGIST
body:
Dear Professor Kim,

My name is Minji Kim, a 2nd-year undergraduate at DGIST. I am curious about how machine learning can help find better battery materials, and I would be grateful for a 15-minute meeting to learn whether there might be an opportunity to join your lab as an undergraduate intern.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Minji Kim
minji@dgist.ac.kr
